proof:
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
  classical
  intro A B w T hw hT hA hB hBbound
  have hAc : (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport A).coeff 0 = 1 := by
    simpa [hA] using M5.SupportPolynomial.support_coeff_zero A
  have hBc : (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport B).coeff 0 = 1 := by
    simpa [hB] using M5.SupportPolynomial.support_coeff_zero B
  have hdegree : (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport B).natDegree ≤ w * T := by
    first
    | apply Nat.le_of_lt
      apply M5.SupportPolynomial.support_degree_bound <;> first | assumption | positivity
    | apply M5.SupportPolynomial.support_degree_bound <;> first | assumption | positivity
  have hpow : 2 ^ (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport B).natDegree ≤ 2 ^ (w * T) :=
    Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) hdegree
  have hprops := M5.Signature.ordinary_gcd_properties
    (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport A) (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport B)
  have hbound := M5.Signature.ordinary_gcd_period_bound
    (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport A) (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport B)
  unfold M5.PhysicalOrder.supportPeriod
  constructor
  · aesop
  constructor
  · apply le_trans _ hpow
    aesop
  · aesop (add safe apply M5.Period.period_law)
